scenarios.title: Kill downloaders reading the service account token
scenarios.description: A pull request to protect-credentials: a new Sigkill rule for curl and wget reading the service account token, the policy broadened from payments to payments and checkout pods, and the security_mmap_file probe dropped. Interpreted by the runtime policy comparator.

scenarios.title: The same change, default comparator
scenarios.description: The same pull request compared by the default comparator: every change is marked, with old and new values, but without security interpretations.

scenarios.title: Switch a policy to monitor mode
scenarios.description: protect-credentials changes from enforce to monitor: its Sigkill rule stays declared but its enforcement is elided.

scenarios.title: Broaden a policy and turn off the policy filter
scenarios.description: The credentials change in a repository that also declares its CRDs, agent values, kernel profiles and workloads: the broadened policy now covers checkout-web, the agent's policy filter is turned off so namespaced and pod-scoped policies won't load, a new policy fails the repository's CRD, and two hooks can't run on the legacy kernel profile.

scenarios.title: A policy library
scenarios.description: One revision of a library covering every hook family: syscalls through a list, a tracepoint, an LSM hook, kernel functions, uprobes, a USDT and a generated list of every syscall, with monitor mode, node and workload scope.

scenarios.title: A deployment at a glance
scenarios.description: One revision with its agent configuration, kernel profiles and the workloads each policy covers.
